subject: Onboarding ingestion: missing purchase id & itemization corrections
messages:
From: Sara Patel <sara.patel@elara-systems.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, onboarding@procure.io
Cc: 
Date: 2026-10-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor intake submitted — ingestion errors noticed

Hi Avery / Procure team,

We submitted our vendor intake package through Procure earlier this morning. When I checked the platform confirmation I noticed two issues: the system did not attach a purchase id for our initial allocation, and the line items were split into three rows when our CSV provides a single consolidated SKU line. Also the spend cap on our account reads $0.00 in the dashboard.

Files attached: elara_onboarding_form.pdf (pdf) — contains our legal & billing info; original SKU spreadsheet included in the form.

Can you confirm receipt and advise next steps? We need the PO in place before our first shipment on Oct 11.

Thanks,
Sara Patel
Head of Logistics | Elara Systems
[sara.patel@elara-systems.com]
(415) 555-0199

From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara.patel@elara-systems.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor intake submitted — ingestion errors noticed

Hi Sara — thanks for flagging this.

Short answer: we saw the same ingestion gap on Procure's side and have opened a ticket with them. In parallel we can provisionally authorize spend so your kickoff isn't blocked. Proposed immediate steps: 

- Issue a provisional PO (provisional_po_7421.pdf attached) for $25,000 to match the expected first-month usage.
- Monica to review and approve a one-time spend cap bump to $50k while ingestion issues are resolved.
- Priyom / Platform team to correct SKU mapping and re-ingest the original file; please confirm which SKU should remain consolidated.

Action requested from you: please confirm the single consolidated SKU label you want us to preserve (the field in your submission reads "ELR-CORE-1000" but the ingestion split it into ELR-CORE-1000-A / -B / -C). If that's correct, tell us which split you want kept; otherwise send a short one-line confirmation and we'll keep ELR-CORE-1000 consolidated.

I've attached a provisional PO so ops can move forward.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Senior Vendor Enablement | Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Elara spendcap + SKU mapping recommendation

Team — quick internal note following Avery's provisional PO:

Context:
- Vendor: Elara Systems (new onboarding)
- Issue: Procure ingestion split a single SKU into three lines and failed to attach a purchase id; dashboard shows spendcap = $0.00.

Recommendation:
1) Temporary spend cap: approve $50,000 for 30 days to cover onboarding and initial shipments.
2) Final PO issuance: once SKU mapping is validated, issue a non-provisional PO (final PO number to be generated).
3) SKU map: see attached sku_map_elara.csv — Priyom, can the platform ingest this and run a reconciliation pass? Mark the consolidated label as ELR-CORE-1000 and collapse A/B/C into that single SKU.

Risk note: if Procure ingestion does not preserve the consolidated mapping, line-level billing will misattribute spend and create reconciliation work later. Suggest we add an audit step and flag invoices that post against ELR-CORE-1000-A/B/C until the migration completes.

Monica
Head of Procurement Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara.patel@elara-systems.com>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-04T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor intake submitted — ingestion errors noticed

Hi Sara — following up with final confirmation.

On Fri, Oct 2, 2026 at 11:22 AM Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team — quick internal note following Avery's provisional PO:
>
> Context: Vendor: Elara Systems (new onboarding)
>
> Recommendation: Temporary spend cap: approve $50,000 for 30 days...

We re-ran the ingestion with the attached sku_map_elara.csv and collapsed ELR-CORE-1000-A/B/C into the consolidated label ELR-CORE-1000. The system produced a new PO id: PO_7421-ELR (attached). Spend cap has been set to $50,000 and is live on the vendor dashboard.

Files attached: PO_7421-ELR.pdf (pdf), ingest_audit_20261004.log (log) — contains the before/after diff from the ingestion run.

Next steps (for visibility):
- Elara: please confirm receipt and that ELR-CORE-1000 appears consolidated in your portal view.
- Redwood billing: flag any invoices posted to ELR-CORE-1000-A/B/C through Oct 11 for manual review.

Thanks for the quick coordination — apologies for the disruption.

Cheers,
Priyom Das
Platform Integrations | Redwood Inference
